draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.61, the 256th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 20th of 20 at S. He went 250th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 79 tackles in 2023, 5th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.
